# SchemaKey

One shape key the schema knows, authored on the source or synthesized.

## Parameters

- `name`: A string. Slider name; the target is `name` or the `name+` / `name-` pair.
- `polarity`: A string (see [KeyPolarity](KeyPolarity.md)). One target or a pair.
- `caption`: A string. Panel caption; the name when empty.
- `region`: A string. The region the key belongs to (panel grouping).
